thread:
lin: quick question for the RFC follow-up: how strict should our cross-account attachment policy be when provisioning operator ENIs in customer VPCs? customers keep asking for least-privilege.

omar: we currently ask for iam:CreateNetworkInterface + ec2:AttachNetworkInterface cross-account role. customers worry about lateral access.

yasmin: propose scoped role with permissions limited to a single subnet + tag constraints. operator tool can assume-role with duration=15m and tag ENI with tenant-id. no standing creds in customer account.

ben: tagging and short-lived assume-role good. how do we prove auditability to customers? they want to see where traffic originated and that operator didn't exec arbitrary calls.

lin: emit signed attestations on every attach/detach with a nonce, timestamp, and operator-job-id. customer can verify signature using our public key. also publish attach events to a per-tenant S3 audit log if they opt-in.

omar: networking concern: some customers block route table updates from cross-account principals. should we fall back to shared-regional-relay?

yasmin: yes hybrid fallback. policy: if attach fails due to policy, create relay binding and switch agent to relay-mode. we MUST notify customer and increment metric attach_policy_blocked.

ben: security note: relay-mode requires proxy-cert workflow (no header forwarding). cert TTL short (default 2m), mint with audit log entry and include attestation referencing original client SAN.

lin: also need observability: span propagation across relay paths so distributed traces show original request path. propose adding x-rdwd-span header signed by operator cert.

omar: perf: ENI gives <10ms improvement for controlplane ops, but cost ~ $X/mo per tenant per region. recommend default=relay, opt-in=eni. document cost and tradeoffs.

yasmin: config sketch for tenant file:
```
tenant_id: example-co
controlplane.local: true
endpoint.mode: eni # eni|relay
eni.request_role_arn: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/rw-enis
audit.s3_bucket: s3://example-co-redwood-ops-logs # optional
proxy_cert_ttl_seconds: 120
```

ben: ops playbook short checklist for attach failures:
- check cross-account role trust policy
- verify subnet has capacity / AZ mapping
- if blocked by security, create relay binding and notify tenant
- rotate any ephemeral keys used during attach

sec-bot: flagged: iam-role-not-limited - please ensure role has condition on aws:ResourceTag/tenant-id

lin: thanks, i'll update RFC follow-up with the assume-role pattern, attestation format, config snippet, and metrics: eni_attach_attempts, eni_attach_blocked_policy, relay_fallback_count, proxy_cert_issues. tagging @omar @yasmin for review. :+1:
